script_text:
Capricorn, this week reshapes your reputation overnight.

Thursday is pressure: the Sun in your 10th House opposes Saturn in your 3rd House, testing contracts and authority. Friday is best because the Jupiter-Neptune sextile activates your 1st House, sharpening intuition and visibility.

By Saturday, the separating Sun-Saturn opposition turns a conversation into a clearer boundary. Venus in Libra in your 7th House sharpens romance and client talks; a negotiation may reveal a money opportunity.

From Sunday through Wednesday, Jupiter favors networking or leads; verify every number before signing. Weekend partnership makes Sunday best for a date or money conversation, protecting your income.

Your best day is Friday because Jupiter sextiles Neptune and expands visibility. Your worst day is Thursday because the Sun opposes Saturn in your career and communication houses.

Use Saturn, your ruling planet and Earth-sign anchor, to document every promise. Follow for daily updates.
